design_system.layout_concept: 3-column asymmetric risk cockpit with compact tabular command bar

selected_panels.name: Primary Segment Vulnerability & Wilson 95% CIs
selected_panels.justification: Primary operational dimension ranked by adverse rate with exact binomial confidence intervals.

selected_panels.name: Non-Linear Parameter Threshold Cliff & Danger Zone
selected_panels.justification: Isolates discrete physical inflection points across 20 continuous driver(s).

selected_panels.name: Exposure Volume vs Adverse Risk Bubble Dispersion
selected_panels.justification: Separates high-volume systemic friction from low-volume niche outliers.

selected_panels.name: 2x2 Orthogonal Risk vs Protective Buffer Matrix
selected_panels.justification: Tests whether protective factors successfully buffer or succumb to primary risk driver.

selected_panels.name: 2D Cross-Tabulation Risk Concentration Heatmap
selected_panels.justification: Bivariate categorical cross-tab (key x mode) exposes sub-node vulnerability hubs.

selected_panels.name: Operational Intake Screening Yield Frontier
selected_panels.justification: Quantifies trade-off between intake discard/scrap % and adverse defect containment.

selected_panels.name: What-If Counterfactual ROI & Excess-Risk Simulator
selected_panels.justification: Allows executive leadership to interactively model 0-100% excess-risk compression scenarios.

selected_panels.name: Actionable Priority Worklist & Incident Triage Table
selected_panels.justification: Equips frontline operations with prioritized record-level retention and recovery queues.
